GSDP is computed across 9 sectors (APPSC-G2 2017). These are the old CSO classification: agriculture-forestry-fishing; mining; manufacturing; electricity-gas-water; construction; trade-hotels; transport-storage-communication; finance-real estate; community and social services .
GVA (basic prices, industry-wise) + product taxes - product subsidies = GSDP (market prices). NSDP = GSDP - depreciation, and AP's per capita income is based on NSDP.
Directorate of Economics & Statistics (DES), AP compiles GSDP; at State level the DESs compile State Domestic Product; for GSDP the economy is divided into 9 sectors (G2 2017).

To address this regulatory gap, the Ministry has proposed the insertion of sub-rule (22) under Rule 65 of the Drugs Rules, 1945 , extending the advertisement restriction to holders of licences to sell, stock, exhibit or offer for sale, or distribute drugs, including retail and wholesale drug lice…

sections.where: Prep notes · Book 2 Polity, Society & IR › B-3 › Election Commission of India - composition, appointment (2023 Act), powers and functions › Disputes regarding election - EC vs courts, Article 329 bar
bullets: Art. 329(a): laws on delimitation and allotment of seats cannot be questioned in court; Art. 329(b): an election can be challenged only by an election petition .

By convention courts do not interfere once the poll process begins; the ECI cannot review a result. Petitions go to the High Court (Parliament, state legislatures) and the Supreme Court for President/VP (Art. 71) (UPSC).

Art. 329(b): an election to Parliament or a state legislature can be questioned only by an election petition under the RPA 1951. Such petitions are tried by the High Court, with appeal to the Supreme Court .
President/VP election disputes: decided by the Supreme Court (Art. 71) .
The ECI does not try election petitions. It decides party and symbol disputes and advises on disqualification.

Free symbols: for RUPPs and independents, allotted from a notified list; latest list May 2025 - 184 symbols (LENSD, 11 Jun 2026).
RUPPs get a common symbol if they contest 2 Lok Sabha seats or 5% of Assembly seats (LENSD, 11 Sep 2026).

Split disputes: Para 15 - the ECI decides which faction is the party, applying the Sadiq Ali (1971) test of majority [GK for the test] (TH, 16 Jun 2026); the ECI acts as a court in recognition and symbol disputes.
Para 16A: the ECI may suspend or withdraw recognition for defying the Model Code of Conduct (TH, 5 May 2026).

items.title: “Immense Opportunities in Food Processing; Youth Should Become Job Creators, Not Job Seekers”: Shri Chirag Paswan
items.summary: Shri Paswan is the Union Minister for Food Processing Industries, while Shri Avinash Joshi is the Secretary of the Ministry. Addressing the 7th Convocation of the National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management, Kundli (NIFTEM-K), Shri Paswan urged graduating students not to restrict themselves to becoming job seekers, but to emerge as job creators, innovators and solution providers.

facts.text: Addressing the 7th Convocation of the National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management, Kundli (NIFTEM-K), Shri Paswan urged graduating students not to restrict themselves to becoming job seekers, but to emerge as job creators, innovators and solution providers.
He said that despite the progress made in recent years, the food processing sector continues to offer enormous untapped potential.
The sector can contribute simultaneously to better food quality, value addition, stronger economic opportunities for farmers, employment generation and reduction of food wastage.
He said that with a population of more than 1.4 billion and changing consumption patterns, India offers substantial opportunities across the food value-addition ecosystem.

bullets: Three stages (Bhabha, 1954): (1) PHWRs run on natural uranium with a heavy-water moderator. (2) Fast breeder reactors burn the plutonium from stage 1 and breed more fuel than they consume. (3) Thorium reactors (AHWR). India's thorium reserves are the world's 3rd largest, about 3.6 lakh tonnes (CDI).
Capacity is 8.78 GW, about 3% of generation. It is expected to reach 22.38 GW by 2031-32. LENSD).
Uranium: Jaduguda and Narwapahar (Jharkhand), Tummalapalle (YSR Kadapa, AP); Indian ore is low-grade (APPCA 2026).

Thorium from monazite and ilmenite beach sands (Kerala, TN, AP, Odisha); fuel for the third stage of the three-stage programme and the AHWR. Thorium about 360,000 t (about 25% of world reserves), natural uranium about 70,000 t (APP).

Rail and logistics delays often disrupt thermal power generation (CDI Block09). Coking coal is imported mainly from Australia; non-coking coal comes from Indonesia and South Africa (APPCA).

bullets: NBFC-MFI: non-deposit-taking, with at least 75% of assets in microfinance loans. A microfinance loan is a collateral-free loan to a household with annual income up to ₹3 lakh (VIS 2026).
MFIN (Microfinance Industry Network): association of NBFC-MFIs, set up 2009 (APPSC GS 2024); later an RBI-recognised self-regulatory organisation .

AP microfinance crisis (2010): multiple lending, over-indebtedness and coercive recovery led to borrower suicides. AP issued the AP Microfinance Institutions (Regulation of Money Lending) Ordinance, Oct 2010 (later an Act, 2011), which made MFIs register with district authorities, restricted doorstep recovery and capped interest . The MFI loan book in AP collapsed.

Sector now (ES 2025-26): 95% women, 80% rural borrowers. Loan share (Mar 2025): NBFC-MFIs 39%, banks 32%, SFBs 16%, NBFCs 12%. Borrowers went from 330 lakh (FY14) to 627 lakh (FY25), but loans outstanding fell 14% in FY25.

items.summary: Himashri Boro, a 20-year-old student from Assam, was travelling alone after a dance competition. bullets: Merchandise exports in FY 2025-26: US$ 441.78 bn, an all-time high, up 0.93%. Goods plus services exports: US$ 860.09 bn (TH, 16 Apr 2026). The earlier figure was US$ 437.70 bn for 2024-25 (IYB).
Top export destinations, 2024-25: USA (19.77%), UAE (8.37%), Netherlands (5.2%), UK (3.32%) and China (3.26%) (IYB). The US has long been the top destination (APPSC 2019 key; APPSC G2 key: U.S.A.).
Electronics was the 3rd-largest export category in FY25, after engineering goods and petroleum products. It grew 32.46% to US$ 38.56 bn, and smartphones made up 62.5% of it (IYB; LENS, Mar 2026).

Largest world-market shares: India is the largest rice exporter, with about 40% of global rice trade (APPCA; LENS). It is 3rd in pharma exports by volume (11th by value) and 7th in refined petroleum exports (LENS, Mar 2026).
India's global rank in 2024: 18th in merchandise exports (1.8% share) and 7th in services exports (4.3% share) (IYB; ES).
